item.title: Africa Quiz: Test Your Knowledge of African Capitals with a 3D Globe
item.description: An offline Android quiz game covering all 54 African countries. Answer capital city questions while an interactive 3D globe spins to each location.

item.title: Wrist Paddle: Classic Pong on Your Garmin Watch
item.description: The 1972 arcade classic, reimagined for your wrist. Play Pong against an adaptive AI opponent on 65+ Garmin watches.

item.title: Azan: Prayer Times on Your Garmin Watch
item.description: A Garmin Connect IQ widget that displays Islamic prayer times with moon phases, sun position charts, and Qibla direction.

item.title: Dino Run: Chrome Dino Game on Your Garmin Watch
item.description: The classic Chrome offline T-Rex runner game, recreated for Garmin watches. Jump over cacti, duck under birds, and chase your high score.

item.title: The Diyanet Prayer Time Method: A Black Box That Can't Be Reproduced
item.description: After months of trying to reproduce the Turkish Diyanet prayer time calculations, we found systematic discrepancies that no amount of parameter tuning can explain. Here’s what we found – and why it matters.
